description: Stable catalog ids and resolvers that turn prompt, validation, execution, runtime, and missing-resource errors into localized user-facing messages, plus routing of account preconditions (sign-in, subscription, credits).

characterizationScenarios.name: Run and missing-resource errors resolve to catalog messages and account preconditions

compatibilityPromises: Unclassified callers may import these internals during inventory; imports from classified domains remain subject to cross-domain rules.
Catalog ids remain stable because telemetry and error-panel UI key on them.

The resolvers typing against missing-media, missing-model, and node-replacement types and counting their groups remain visible as cross-domain coupling; classification does not grant dependency exceptions.
